representative_works: 《苏子》三十一篇（《汉书·艺文志》著录，早佚）
帛书《战国纵横家书》十六章游说辞与书信
historical_significance: 苏秦（？—前284），字季子，东周雒阳（今洛阳）人，战国纵横家、外交家、谋略家，师从鬼谷子。早年游说秦周失败、遭家人讥笑后闭门攻读《阴符》，'期年揣摩成'，以'锥刺股'成为中国意志修炼范式的原点。出山后自弱燕起步连环借势，游说燕赵韩魏齐楚六国'合众弱以攻一强'，组建合纵联盟，任从约长、兼佩六国相印，使秦十五年不敢出函谷关——中国历史上规模最大的一次外交联盟工程。联盟解体后转入长期反间：伪装得罪于燕而入齐为客卿，劝齐厚葬、高宫室、伐宋以耗损齐国国力，为燕破齐做死间铺垫。齐大夫争宠遣刺客刺之，苏秦重伤将死，献'车裂徇市悬赏'之策诱出刺客伏诛——'虽死，其计犹杀其仇'。1973年马王堆帛书《战国纵横家书》出土，证实《史记》所记苏秦年辈多有错乱，其真实活动晚于张仪，实为燕昭王时期的死间——两千年史册本身也成为其骗局的最后一件抵押品。
core_thoughts: 合纵均势法（合众弱以攻一强、地缘政治联盟设计）
揣情量权法（揣摩之术：揣情以度人心，量权以称国力）
因势利导游说法（面陈其利、前提植入、后果放大的说服结构）
排比气势论证法（对偶铺陈造势、言而无文行之不远）
刺股淬志法（失败归因于己、一年闭关专项淬炼）
多米诺预警法（坐视不救者即下一张骨牌、五国共救条款）
诈死设饵法（车裂徇市悬赏、把自身毁灭设计为捕获工具）
死间破国法（十年潜伏、以虚荣建议耗损敌国国本）
忠信重估法（使命型忠诚对俗套名节的价值重排）
连环借势法（每次小成功抵押给下一站的杠杆链）
famous_quote: 使我有雒阳负郭田二顷，吾岂能佩六国相印乎！
influence: 苏秦的合纵体系使秦国十五年不敢东出函谷关，开创了中国地缘政治论与多国联盟战略的先河；其'揣摩'之术经《鬼谷子》系统化，成为历代说客、谋士与谈判者的基础功法；'悬梁刺股'的锥刺股典故塑造了东亚文化圈两千年来的苦学意志范式；其死间实践被《孙子兵法》'用间篇'的'死间'概念提供了最完整的历史样本；帛书《战国纵横家书》的出土更使苏秦成为史料批判与战国史重构的关键案例。现代地缘政治分析、谈判学、竞争情报与危机预警中处处可见其方法论遗产。

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 面对一个实力超群的强权，弱者不与其单独媾和，而是把地理上利害相关的诸弱联合成一个战略整体，'合众弱以攻一强'，以联盟合力恢复力量均势。要害有三：其一，均势研判先于联盟设计——苏秦深谙天下山川形胜与各国实力现状，先论证'秦强而六国弱'的力量失衡格局，再提出对策；其二，联盟的纽带是地缘的相互依存——六国'表里相属、唇齿相依'，一国被攻、五国必救，把每个成员的安全利益焊进盟约；其三，联盟必须有一体化的行动纲领——'秦攻一国，五国共救'的协同方案、交质盟誓的组织形式，使合纵不止是认知体系更是一套可执行的军事-外交操作系统。方法论签名：对抗强权，先算清'单打必败、合纵可胜'的账，再把账变成盟约。
thinking_modes.definition_en: When one power towers over all, the weak must never appease it alone: they must weld the geographically interdependent weak into one strategic body—'unite the many weak to attack the one strong'—and restore balance through coalition. Balance must be diagnosed before the coalition is designed; the coalition's glue is geographic interdependence ('one attacked, five rescue'); and the alliance needs an integrated action program—hostage exchanges, oaths, and mutual-aid clauses—so that the vertical alliance is an executable military-diplomatic operating system, not just an insight.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《史记·苏秦列传》《战国策·秦一/赵二》；帛书《战国纵横家书》相关章
process_zh: 研判失衡：测绘各国地缘、兵力、粮储与地形，论证强权崛起导致的力量失衡与'多米诺骨牌'式的连环兼并前景
锁定共同威胁：向每一国点明'共同的危险来自强权的侧翼'，把各国分散的恐惧收拢为一个指认对象
设计互保盟约：立'秦攻一国、五国共救'的具体协同条款——谁断粮道、谁出精兵、谁守何关，逐国写明
结盟固约：洹水之上交质献血、共尊一约，并以'从约长'统筹联盟，使秦十五年不敢出函谷关
process_en: Diagnose imbalance: survey terrain, armies, grain and geography to prove the power asymmetry and the domino-fallback prospect
Name the common threat: point each state to the same flanking danger, fusing scattered fears into one recognized adversary
Draft mutual-aid clauses: specify who cuts supply lines, who sends elites, who guards which pass when the strong power attacks any one
Seal the coalition: exchange hostages, swear by the Huan river, appoint a coalition chief—fifteen years of deterrence follow
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 合众弱以攻一强——六国从亲，则秦甲不敢出于函谷。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Unite the many weak to attack the one strong—when the six states stand as kin, the Qin army dares not cross Hangu Pass.
representative_cases_zh: 洹水之盟（约前333年）：苏秦先说燕、赵，再驱车韩魏齐楚，以'宁为鸡口无为牛后'激韩、以'合纵则王连横则帝'动楚，六国歃血为盟，苏秦佩六国相印任从约长——《史记》所载最强外交联盟工程
秦兵十五年不出函谷关：联盟的威慑红利不在一场会战而在常态抑制——均势的成果以对手的'不动'来计量
反例警示：秦使欺齐魏共攻赵、联盟瓦解后山东旋即沦入各个击破——互保条款失去执行，均势设计再精妙也归于零
representative_cases_en: The Huan River covenant (c.333 BC): Su Qin swayed Yan and Zhao, shamed Han ('rather be a chicken's beak than an ox's rear'), moved Chu with 'vertical alliance makes you king'—six states swore one oath and Su Qin wore six chancellor seals
Fifteen years of Qin deterrence: the dividend of balance is not a battle won but the adversary's inaction—deterrence measured in the enemy's stillness
Counter-case: when Qin bribed Qi and Wei to attack Zhao and the coalition collapsed, the east fell to conquest one by one—mutual-aid clauses unenforced void the finest design
modern_applications_zh: 多边安全联盟与集体防御机制设计（北约第五条款即'五国共救'的现代版）
反垄断监管中中小竞争者的联合应对策略
供应链联盟：中小企业抱团对冲单一巨头采购压价
国际气候谈判中的立场联盟构建
modern_applications_en: Collective-defense design (NATO Article 5 as the modern 'five rescue one')
Coalition strategy for small competitors facing a dominant platform
Supply-chain alliances hedging monopsony pricing power
Positional coalitions in multilateral climate negotiations

thinking_modes.name_en: Sizing the Situation and Probing the Mind
thinking_modes.definition_zh: 游说之先必先'揣摩'：揣情——以己度人，揣测对方的好恶、真伪与内心实意；量权——分析对方的强弱、轻重、虚实、通塞等外部条件。揣是主观判断，摩是以言试探使其内心外露。要害有三：其一，先内后外——先摸清听者的心理底牌，再称量其国家的客观条件，两账合一方能定说辞；其二，揣摩是可修炼的技术而非天赋——苏秦潦倒而归后闭门苦读《阴符》一年，'太公阴符之谋'即揣摩之术的系统训练；其三，揣的成果决定说的分层——对同一命题，对不同君主给出的利害版本各不相同，因为揣得的恐惧与欲望各不相同。方法论签名：不揣而说，等于闭眼开药方。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Before persuading, 'chui-mo': chui—probing the listener's likes, fears and hidden intent by putting yourself in his place; mo—weighing the objective conditions of his state: strength, weight, voids and blockages. Chui is judgment; mo is verbal probing that draws the mind into the open. Probing precedes both inner and outer assessment, it is a trainable craft (Su Qin drilled the Yinfu for a year in obscurity), and its findings stratify the pitch: the same proposition is told in different gain-loss versions because each ruler's probed fears differ. Persuading without probing is prescribing with shut eyes.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《鬼谷子·揣篇/摩篇》及其苏秦实践；《战国策·秦一》'期年揣摩成'
process_zh: 量权建档：对游说对象国建立'强弱、轻重、虚实、通塞'四维档案——地形、兵力、粮储、外交处境逐项称量
揣情画像：揣测君主个人的好恶、忌讳、真伪与野心，区分'国之利'与'君之欲'两条底牌线
以摩试金：用试探性言辞投石问路，从对方的反应中校准揣情的误差，使其内心实意外露
定策分层：据揣摩结论分层定制说辞——恐惧版本、欲望版本、荣誉版本，各配一套利害论证
process_en: Build the weighing file: terrain, troops, grain, diplomatic position—quantify each dimension
Profile the mind: probe the ruler's likes, taboos, sincerity and ambition; separate 'what profits the state' from 'what the ruler craves'
Probe with words: cast trial statements, calibrate your read from the reactions, draw the hidden intent into the open
Stratify the pitch: from the probe, build fear-, desire- and honor-versions of the same case, each with its own gain-loss argument
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 期年，揣摩成——不揣其情，不量其权，而言者盲也。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: A year of drilling and the craft was complete—to speak without probing minds and weighing power is to speak blind.
representative_cases_zh: 锥刺股与《阴符》闭关（前337年前后）：游说秦周失败、家人讥笑后，苏秦闭室遍观藏书，得太公《阴符》伏而诵之，'期年揣摩成'——把失败归因于揣摩之术未精而非命运不济
说赵肃侯：先量权指出'秦不敢攻赵者，恐韩魏议其后'，再揣情点明韩魏若降赵必独承其祸——外账内账并进，赵王'奉国以从'
反例警示：苏秦始说秦惠王时引经据典铺陈'并诸侯吞天下'，却未揣秦王初立忌锋芒之实情，遭'毛羽不丰满者不可以高飞'婉拒——工具未成而先出鞘，正是揣摩功课未足的现场教学
representative_cases_en: The needle and the Yinfu retreat (c.337 BC): after failing with Qin and Zhou and being mocked at home, Su Qin attributed failure not to fate but to an unperfected craft, and drilled the Yinfu for a year
Swaying King Su of Zhao: he weighed the fact that Qin feared Han-Wei in its rear, then probed Zhao's fear of being left alone—both ledgers converged, and the king 'offered his state to the alliance'

Counter-case: Su Qin's first grandiose pitch to King Hui of Qin ignored the young king's caution and was politely refused ('a bird with unfledged wings cannot fly high')—craft unready, blade unsheathed too early
modern_applications_zh: 商务谈判前的对手画像与利益图谱（BATNA 分析的东方原版）
用户研究：揣情=共情访谈，量权=市场数据
外交与公关的受众分层传播策略
风险投资尽调中的'人'与'事'双线核查
modern_applications_en: Counterparty profiling and interest mapping before negotiation (an Eastern BATNA)
User research: chui as empathy interviews, mo as market data
Audience-segmented messaging in diplomacy and PR
VC due diligence probing both the team and the market

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 游说的最高纪律是'面陈其利，不言其德'：每一场游说都从对方自身的利益出发、设身处地替对方谋划，绝口不提盟主或自己得到什么。要害有四：其一，立场伪装——每说一国都'似乎设身处地替对方考虑'，使对方放下戒心；其二，前提植入——在复杂矛盾的利害网中舍掉其余、强调一端，以'此国与强权的敌对关系'为暗含前提展开论证；其三，后果放大——把'行我策'与'不行我策'两种后果的受益与受害程度各自夸大，加大反差逼对方下决心；其四，辅助手段——必要时借地理事实加固论证，辅以褒扬与激将。方法论签名：说服不是推销自己的方案，而是让对方以为是他的方案。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The supreme discipline of persuasion: argue each case purely from the listener's own interest, never mentioning what you or your coalition gains. Four essentials—wear the advocate's mask (speak as if solely in his interest); implant premises (drop all other factors and foreground only his conflict with the hegemon); magnify consequences (inflate both the gains of adopting and the costs of refusing until the gap forces decision); and reinforce with geography, praise and provocation. Persuasion is not selling your plan—it is making him believe the plan is his.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《史记·苏秦列传》说韩魏齐楚各段；《战国策》游说辞
process_zh: 换位定稿：删去一切'我方所得'的表述，全篇改写为'贵国得失'的第一人称利害账
植入前提：先以一句不可辩驳的地理或事实陈述锁定'强权是你唯一敌人'的前提，后续论证全部在此前提下展开
二分后果：并陈'从'与'不从'两套结局——从则'称王'，不从则'割地事秦'，把反差拉到极限
情理并击：以褒扬其国力军威铺垫其虚荣，以'宁为鸡口'之语激其羞耻，最后归到'王自择之'
process_en: Rewrite in his interest: strike every mention of your own gain; render the whole case as his first-person ledger of loss and gain
Implant the premise: open with an unarguable geographic fact fixing 'the hegemon is your only enemy,' then argue entirely within it
Bifurcate consequences: adoption brings kingship, refusal brings ceding land and serving the tiger—stretch the contrast to the limit
Strike reason and emotion: flatter his state's strength to feed pride, provoke his shame with the chicken's-beak line, then hand him the choice
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 夫贤人在而天下服，一人用而天下从——说人之术，在因其所欲而导之。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Speak to what he already desires, and the great cause follows—persuasion leads a man by his own wants.
representative_cases_zh: 激韩：'宁为鸡口，无为牛后'——一句话把'事秦'翻译成'做牛后'的耻辱，韩王勃然变色'愿献社稷为从'
动楚：'从合则楚王，横成则秦帝'——把联盟前途直接等价于楚王的帝业，威王的野心替苏秦完成了说服
说燕：全篇不提燕将出资出兵，只反复论证'秦攻燕必行千里难守，赵攻燕不过百里易至'——用纯地理账让燕文公自感必须联赵
反例警示：直接请求六国'帮我抗秦'者，无一人能说动一国之君——立场一旦暴露为利己，游说即死
representative_cases_en: Provoking Han: 'better a chicken's beak than an ox's rear'—one line reframed serving Qin as servitude, and the enraged king joined
Moving Chu: 'with the vertical alliance Chu becomes king; with the horizontal, Qin becomes emperor'—the king's own ambition closed the deal
Persuading Yan: never asked for a single soldier; proved by pure geography that Qin's assault must march a thousand li while Zhao's needs only a hundred—Yan concluded it must ally with Zhao
Counter-case: any envoy who openly said 'help me fight Qin' persuaded no one—self-interest exposed kills the pitch
modern_applications_zh: 销售与商务谈判的买方立场论证（把方案翻译成客户的KPI语言）
公益倡导：把宏大议题转译为受众自身利害
产品文案的'你'视角写作法
组织变革沟通：向每个部门回答'这对你部门意味着什么'
modern_applications_en: Buyer-side framing in sales: translate the plan into the client's KPI language
Advocacy: render grand issues in the audience's own stakes
'You'-perspective copywriting
Change management: answer 'what does this mean for my unit' for each department

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 游说的文采本身构成说服力的一半：以对偶、排比、铺陈造势，先极言对象国之富强（田肥美、民殷富、战车万乘、奋击百万），再指陈其危局，令听者先骄傲后恐惧，情绪被节奏卷着走。要害有三：其一，'言而无文，行之不远'——华丽辞藻不是装饰而是传播力与感染力的载体；其二，铺陈要有账目感——苏秦的排比不是空话，每一项都对应可指认的国土、兵力与物产数字，气势以事实为弹药；其三，'言多'在关键语境是必要的——围绕一个论点反复堆叠，把对方的心理防线磨到接受为止。方法论签名：逻辑说服头脑，节奏征服心理——排比是把论证变成洪水的河床。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Rhetoric itself carries half the persuasion: parallelism, antithesis and amplification first paint the state's wealth in inventory-laden cadences, then its peril—pride followed by fear, the listener carried by rhythm. Style is not decoration but the vehicle of reach ('words without polish travel not far'); the parade must be auditable—each clause maps to real land, troops and produce, momentum with facts for ammunition; and 'much talk' is necessary around one point, eroding resistance by repetition. Logic convinces the mind; cadence conquers the psyche—parallelism is the riverbed that turns argument into flood.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《战国策·秦一》'苏秦始将连横'说辞；《史记·苏秦列传》各国游说段
process_zh: 清点弹药：把对象国的山川、物产、兵力、户数整理成可入句的实数清单
四段造势：国情颂扬（极言其强）→ 敌情点破（极言其危）→ 方案铺陈（合纵条款的排比展开）→ 后果二分（从则王/不从则亡）
节奏押韵：以对偶与递进造句，使长段说辞听来如军鼓推进，一层紧过一层
收束留权：最后一句永远还给听者——'愿大王少留意''王自择之'，气势做满而决策权示还
process_en: Stock ammunition: turn the state's terrain, produce, troops and households into quotable numbers
Four-movement momentum: praise the state's strength, expose its peril, parade the alliance clauses, split the outcomes (king or vassal)
March the rhythm: couplets and crescendos so the speech advances like a drum line, tighter with each turn
Return the choice: close with 'your majesty may ponder'—full momentum, but the decision visibly handed back
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 言而无文，行之不远——气盛则言宜，言宜则听者从。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Words without polish travel not far—when momentum swells, speech fits, and the listener follows.
representative_cases_zh: 说秦开场：'西有巴蜀汉中之利，北有胡貉代马之用，南有巫山黔中之限，东有肴函之固……'——五方位排比一气呵成，秦虽不用其策，后来秦国战略竟循此路线而行
说赵：'山东建国莫强于赵……地方二千余里，带甲数十万，车千乘，骑万匹，粟支数年'——账目式排比让赵王的骄傲先于恐惧到位
说楚：'地方五千余里，带甲百万，车千乘，骑万匹，粟支十年，此霸王之资也'——同一句式复制到第四国，节奏本身成为品牌
反例警示：同样内容若以干瘪陈述呈递，六国君主多会以'容后再议'拖延——气势不足，利害再对也进不了决策议程
representative_cases_en: Opening to Qin: five directional clauses of wealth and terrain in one breath—Qin rejected the plan yet later followed the very route he outlined
To Zhao: an inventory cadence—2,000 li, hundreds of thousands armed, grain for years—letting pride arrive before fear
To Chu: the same sentence-form for the fourth state; the rhythm itself had become the brand
Counter-case: the same content delivered as dry prose earned 'we shall consider it'—without momentum, correct analysis never reaches the agenda
modern_applications_zh: 融资路演与关键提案的开场三分钟结构
政策报告的'数字排比'写法（每项数据可核查）
演讲与动员文案的节奏设计
品牌口号的对偶与递进造句
modern_applications_en: The first three minutes of a fundraising pitch
Data-parallel policy writing with auditable figures
Rhythm design for speeches and mobilization copy
Slogan craft via antithesis and crescendo

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 大败之后不做归因于环境的受害者，而做归因于技能的工程师：游说秦周失败、'妻不下纴，嫂不为炊，父母不与言'的奇耻之后，苏秦喟然叹曰'此皆秦之罪也'——把失败全部认领到自己身上，随即闭室不出，遍观所藏之书，得太公《阴符》伏而诵之，'期年，揣摩成'。要害有三：其一，耻辱转化为燃料——'安有说人主不能出其金玉锦绣、取卿相之尊者乎'的自我追问把屈辱重定义为技术欠账；其二，训练有明确的主攻教材与期限——不是泛泛读书，而是锁定一部关键典籍、以一年为期完成专项淬炼；其三，以身体痛苦对抗精神懈怠——'读书欲睡，引锥自刺其股，血流至足'，用生理疼痛强制维持学习强度。方法论签名：低谷不是休止符而是集中训练营——把世界的冷眼换算成课表。
thinking_modes.definition_en: After catastrophic failure, be an engineer of skill, not a victim of circumstance: after Qin and Zhou rejected him and even his family would not cook for him, Su Qin sighed 'this is all my fault'—claimed the failure whole, shut his door, reread every book he owned, found Taigong's Yinfu, drilled it for one year, and the craft was complete. Shame becomes fuel (his self-interrogation redefined humiliation as a technical debt); training has a specific canon and a deadline; and bodily pain police mental slack—the needle to the thigh when sleepiness came. A trough is not a rest but a boot camp: convert the world's contempt into a curriculum.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《战国策·秦一》：'读书欲睡，引锥自刺其股，血流至足''期年揣摩成'；《史记·苏秦列传》
process_zh: 认领失败：拒绝一切外因归因，将失败完整归结为自身技能不足——'此皆秦之罪也'的自我判决书
锁定主攻教材：从全部藏书中挑出一部与核心技能直接对应的典籍（《阴符》之于揣摩），不再泛读
定期限高强度：以一年为约，伏案专攻，以锥刺股的生理强制对抗懈怠，'血流至足'不停
出关复训：学成即重返市场验证——次年游说列国，之前的每一次碰壁都变成新说辞的案例库
process_en: Claim the failure: refuse all external attribution; sentence yourself—'this is all my fault'
Pick one canon: from all your books choose the one that maps to the failing skill; stop general reading
Set a deadline and endure: one year, full intensity; use bodily discomfort to enforce discipline—blood to the feet, unbroken
Return and redeploy: re-enter the market the moment training ends; every earlier rejection becomes casework for the new pitch
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 此皆秦之罪也——安有说人主不能出其金玉锦绣、取卿相之尊者乎？期年，揣摩成。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: This is all my fault—how can one who would sway rulers fail to win gold and chancellorship? A year later, the craft was complete.
representative_cases_zh: 锥刺股（前337年前后）：说秦失败归乡，'妻不下纴，嫂不为炊'，苏秦发愤锥股苦读一年，出山即连佩六国相印——中国 &'悬梁刺股'& 意志训练范式的原点
前倨后恭的对照检验：佩印归乡时嫂子'蛇行匍匐'，苏秦叹'使我有雒阳负郭田二顷，吾岂能佩六国相印乎'——正是当年的一贫如洗逼出了那一年闭关，境遇越惨，淬火越纯
反例警示：同样失败的多数游士归因于'诸侯无道'或'时运不济'，转年继续用旧说辞碰壁——不做技能归因的人，失败只是重复的彩排
representative_cases_en: The needle to the thigh (c.337 BC): rejected by Qin, uncooked-for at home, Su Qin drilled for one year and emerged to wear six seals—the origin point of China's 'hanging hair, needling thigh' will-training paradigm

The snob-filter test: returning in glory, his sister-in-law groveled; he sighed that two qing of good farmland would have kept him from ever earning six seals—utter poverty had forced the year of mastery
Counter-case: most failed itinerants blamed 'unworthy lords' or 'bad luck' and returned with the same old pitch—without skill-attribution, failure is just rehearsal for repeating it
modern_applications_zh: 职业低谷期的'专项闭关'：锁定一项核心技能以固定周期重修
创业失败后的技术性复盘（把'市场不好'改写为'我的哪个假设错了'）
深度工作的物理强制机制（环境隔离、身体节律、防懈怠设计）
考试与竞技的赛前封闭集训法
modern_applications_en: Career troughs as boot camp: pick one core skill and re-drill it on a fixed cycle
Post-startup-failure review: rewrite 'the market was bad' as 'which of my assumptions failed'
Physical enforcement mechanisms for deep work (isolation, bodily rhythm, anti-slack design)
Closed pre-competition training camps

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 从博弈结构推演连锁崩溃：苏秦睿智地看到，如果一国被强权攻击而其余诸国坐视不救，后果将是'犹极多米诺，一个倒下，其余依次倒塌'。要害有三：其一，把孤立事件读为序列事件——韩魏被蚕食不是韩魏之祸，而是赵楚之祸的前置章节；其二，预警必须与责任绑定——只预警不行动等于纵容，'坐视不救'本身就是下一张倒下的骨牌；其三，预警的说服用法——向每一国指出'你就是第五张骨牌'，把远期风险折算成当期决策压力。方法论签名：在别人的危机里看见自己的结局，是战略成熟的开始。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Deduce cascading collapse from the game's structure: if the hegemon devours one state while the rest watch, 'like dominoes, one falls and the rest follow.' Read isolated events as a sequence (the nibbling of Han-Wei is the preface to Zhao-Chu's doom); bind warning to obligation (to watch unrescued is itself the next domino); and use the warning persuasively—show each ruler he is the fifth domino, converting distant risk into present decision pressure. Seeing your own ending in another's crisis is where strategic maturity begins.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《史记·苏秦列传》说赵段'秦攻韩魏则赵必危'推演；帛书《战国纵横家书》相关书信
process_zh: 绘制吞并序列：按强权的攻击成本排序，推演'先易后难'的蚕食顺序图
标注连带效应：在序列图上为每个节点标注'此节点倒下后，谁的成本曲线改变'——通常是邻国的防御价值归零
责任绑定：在盟约中写明'见攻必救'，把预警从道德呼吁升格为契约义务
折现到当下：向潜在受害者出示序列图，把'第N张骨牌'的远期命运折算为本年度的结盟决策
process_en: Map the devouring sequence: rank targets by the hegemon's cost of attack; project the easy-first order of nibbling
Mark knock-on effects: at each node note whose defensive value collapses next—usually a neighbor's
Bind obligation: write 'attack one, all rescue' into the covenant—warning upgraded from moral appeal to contractual duty
Discount to now: show each prospective victim the sequence chart; convert the fate of the Nth domino into this year's alliance decision
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 一国有难，五国共救——不救者，即是下一张骨牌。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: One state in peril, five come to its rescue—he who watches unrescuing is the next domino.
representative_cases_zh: 说赵的推演链：'秦攻韩魏，无大山大川之限，渐蚕食至都城；韩魏不能抗秦必称臣；秦无韩魏之患，则祸必中于赵'——三步推演把二十年后的威胁放进赵肃侯当日的决策桌
合纵盟约的互救条款：'秦攻楚，则齐魏出精兵……秦攻赵，则韩军宜阳……五国不遵守约者，五国共伐之'——预警写成了可执行的战争预案
历史验证：六国未始终贯彻合纵而最终逐个被灭——多米诺预言的全部悲剧在于每张骨牌都以为自己可以例外
反例警示：齐湣王坐视五国消耗而独吞宋国肥己，终招五国伐齐、几乎亡国——把邻人的火警当戏剧看的人，火会烧到自己的剧场
representative_cases_en: The chain to Zhao: Qin devours Han-Wei unopposed, Han-Wei submit, and 'the calamity must land in Zhao's lap'—a three-step deduction put a twenty-year threat on today's desk
Mutual-rescue clauses in the covenant: which army cuts lines, which guards which pass, and 'whoever breaks the pact, five states punish him'—early warning written as executable war plans
History's verdict: the six fell one by one precisely because each domino believed it could be the exception

Counter-case: King Min of Qi watched the others burn while annexing Song—and was himself nearly annihilated by a five-state coalition; he who watches a neighbor's fire alarm as theater will feel the flames in his own hall
modern_applications_zh: 地缘政治风险分析中的'侵略序列'推演（分析师常用方法）
供应链风险：单一节点失效的级联效应建模
金融系统性风险：'大而不能倒'与'倒一而连三'的监管预警
竞争分析：细分市场逐个被巨头攻陷的次序预测
modern_applications_en: Sequencing aggression in geopolitical risk analysis
Supply-chain cascade modeling of single-node failure
Systemic financial risk: too-big-to-fail and fail-one-fall-three warning
Competitive analysis: predicting the order in which a giant takes adjacent segments

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 把自身的毁灭设计为捕获凶手的饵：苏秦在齐国遇刺重伤将死，对齐王说'臣即死，车裂臣以徇于市，曰苏秦为燕作乱于齐，如此则臣之贼必得矣'——以车裂酷刑为悬赏公告，用'死后受辱'的假象诱刺客出头领赏。要害有三：其一，看穿凶手的动机结构——刺客行刺是为'争宠'之名，悬赏公告恰好把'刺苏秦'从隐匿功劳变成可领赏的功勋；其二，敢于把最惨烈的下场用作工具——常人避车裂唯恐不及，谋士却能反向开发它的信息传播价值；其三，死亡不是计划的终点而是最后一个执行节点——'苏秦虽死，其计犹杀其仇'，用死亡完成最后一次计算。方法论签名：真正的深谋远虑，是把连自己的死都编进棋谱。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Design your own destruction as bait to catch your killer: mortally wounded in Qi, Su Qin told the king, 'When I die, tear my body by chariots in the marketplace, proclaiming that Su Qin plotted for Yan in Qi—then my assassin will surely come forward.' The execution notice converts the assassin's hidden crime into a claimable reward. Read the killer's motive structure; dare to weaponize the most gruesome fate; and treat death as the plan's final execution node—'though dead, his stratagem still slew his enemy.' The deepest foresight writes even your own death into the game record.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《史记·苏秦列传》：'臣即死，车裂臣以徇于市……则臣之贼必得矣'
process_zh: 动机复盘：遇刺后先复盘凶手'为何而刺'——争宠者要的是功劳的承认，而非沉默的杀戮
逆向设计诱饵：把'处死刺客'的官方动作换成'表彰刺客'的假公告，让罪犯自投罗网
接受代价：计成必以自己身后受辱为抵押——车裂徇市，本人名誉的最后一枚筹码也押上牌桌
死讯闭环：确认刺客伏诛、反间身份按预定时间暴露，棋局在人死后仍按谱收官
process_en: Autopsy the motive: establish why he struck—rival courtiers crave recognition, not silent murder
Design the bait in reverse: replace 'hunt the assassin' with a fake proclamation crediting 'whoever slew the traitor'—let the criminal claim his prize
Accept the price: the scheme is collateralized by your own posthumous disgrace—chariot-tearing in the marketplace, the last chip on the table
Close the loop after death: the assassin is executed, the espionage surfaces on schedule, and the endgame plays out per the record
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 苏秦虽死，其计犹能杀其仇——虽死，犹为之用也。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Though Su Qin died, his stratagem still slew his enemy—dead, he was still in play.
representative_cases_zh: 齐都车裂徇市（前284年前后）：苏秦遇刺将死，献'车裂悬赏'之策，刺客果为领赏而出头伏诛——司马迁录此为'死间'谋略的极限样本
身前身后双重反间：生前以客卿身份'劝齐厚葬、高宫室苑囿'耗损齐国国力，死后反间事实公开引发齐燕交恶——一人之力贯穿齐国的由盛转衰
反例警示：遇刺后若按常例'王为捕贼'，凶手隐匿无功无赏，永不露面——常规处置保护的是凶手，非常规设计才保护受害者
representative_cases_en: Chariot-tearing in the Qi capital (c.284 BC): the deathbed bait drew the assassin out to claim his reward—the limit sample of the 'dead spy' stratagem in Sima Qian's record

Double counterintelligence: alive, as honored guest minister he counseled lavish burials and palaces to drain Qi's strength; dead, the revealed espionage fractured Qi-Yan relations—one man threaded Qi's turn from zenith to decline
Counter-case: the standard 'king will hunt the killer' leaves the assassin unrewarded and hidden forever—routine procedure protects the killer; unconventional design protects the victim
modern_applications_zh: 网络安全中的蜜罐诱捕（把自己伪装成高价值受害目标）
反舞弊调查的'钓鱼公告'设计
品牌打假：故意放出可追溯的假货交易线索
危机公关预案：预写'身后'剧本与信息释放时序
modern_applications_en: Honeypots: posing as a high-value victim to trap attackers
Anti-fraud bait proclamations in investigations
Anti-counterfeiting: releasing traceable bait listings
Crisis playbooks pre-scripting posthumous disclosures and timing

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 以十年为期的顶级反间：苏秦伪装得罪于燕而'亡走'齐，取得齐湣王信任为客卿，然后专劝齐王做三件事——厚葬以明孝、高宫室苑囿以示 Pride、伐宋以广地——每一件都合乎君主虚荣而消耗国本：葬礼与宫殿抽空财政，伐宋招致诸侯侧目。要害有三：其一，间谍的最高形态不是偷情报而是'进馊主意'——让敌国的重大决策都出自它自己的君王之意；其二，建议必须真伪难辨——每条劝进都符合当时的'强国叙事'，短期内看不出任何破绽；其三，代价是彻底的名誉抵押——'忠信'之名尽毁、身后被诛贼所刺、史料长期误记为反复小人，至帛书出土方得翻转。方法论签名：毁掉一个强国最隐蔽的方式，是成为它最信任的谋士。
thinking_modes.definition_en: Counterintelligence on a ten-year horizon: feigning disgrace in Yan, Su Qin 'fled' to Qi, won King Min's trust as guest minister, and then urged exactly what flattered and bled the state—lavish burials for filial show, towering palaces to display pride, the conquest of Song for glory—each draining the treasury or provoking the lords. Espionage supreme is not stealing secrets but feeding ruinous counsel that the enemy's own king believes to be his idea; every proposal must fit the era's strong-state narrative and show no crack for years; and the price is total reputational collateral—branded a turncoat for two millennia until the silk manuscripts surfaced. The stealthiest way to break a great power is to become its most trusted counselor.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《史记·苏秦列传》；帛书《战国纵横家书》苏秦书信十六章
process_zh: 取得信任锚点：以'得罪出奔'的人设入境，让敌国相信收留你是在打对手的脸
递送虚荣型建议：专挑君主最想听、最合强国叙事的议题（厚葬、宫室、扩地）献策，条条耗国本而无一字露破绽
控制消耗节奏：不一次榨干，随君主的执政周期匀速进言，让国力流失混入'自然兴衰'的背景噪音
预设暴露剧本：反间事实在自己死后或联盟需要时按计划公开，把敌国的愤怒转化为盟友的战略窗口
process_en: Anchor trust: enter under a defector persona so the enemy believes hosting you slaps your former master
Deliver vanity counsel: propose only what the king longs to hear—burials, palaces, expansion—each draining the state without a visible flaw
Pace the attrition: never drain at once; drip counsel across the reign so the loss blends into background decay
Pre-script exposure: let the espionage surface on schedule—after your death or when the alliance needs it—turning enemy rage into an ally's strategic window
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 虽为间而不露，虽毁国而其君自谓得计——死间之极，敌不疑而国已虚。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: A spy unseen, a state ruined while its king believes himself shrewd—the supreme dead spy leaves the enemy un suspecting and the country hollow.
representative_cases_zh: 劝齐厚葬高宫（前288年后）：苏秦引导齐湣王以空前规格治丧筑苑，'欲以敝齐而为燕'——齐国的府库在'孝'与'威'的美名下被搬空
怂恿伐宋（前286年）：齐灭宋招致诸侯震恐，成为五国伐齐的直接导火索——苏秦借宋国这块肥肉给齐国套上绞索
帛书平反（1973年马王堆出土）：《战国纵横家书》十六篇书信证明苏秦实为燕之死间，司马迁时代已误记其年辈与事迹——史书本身也成为反间的受害者
反例警示：急功近利的间谍一旦行为超出'忠诚谋士'的剧本（如索取过高权位），信任链即刻断裂——死间的全部艺术在'演得比忠臣更像忠臣'
representative_cases_en: Lavish burials and palaces (after 288 BC): counsel that emptied Qi's treasury under the banners of filial piety and majesty
Inciting the conquest of Song (286 BC): the prize that terrified the lords and triggered the five-state coalition—Su Qin used Song as the rope Qi tied around its own neck
Vindication by silk (Mawangdui, 1973): sixteen letters proved Su Qin was Yan's dead spy; even the history books had been collateral damage of the deception
Counter-case: any spy exceeding the 'loyal counselor' script—demanding too much power—snaps the trust chain at once; the whole art is playing the loyalist more convincingly than the loyalists
modern_applications_zh: 竞争情报的长期潜伏与'建议式影响'（合规边界内）
战略耐心：通过合规咨询与标准参与实现长期影响力
舆论战中的'自家人说自家坏话'效应研究
审计与风控对'过于顺耳的外部建议'的识别机制
modern_applications_en: Long-covert competitive intelligence and influence-through-advice (within legal bounds)
Strategic patience: long-horizon influence via consulting and standards participation
Studying the 'criticism from one's own side' effect in information warfare
Audit controls that flag external advice that flatters too well

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 当'忠信'的俗套定义妨碍使命时，重新为忠诚定价：遭谗言后苏秦对燕王自辩——'孝如曾参，义如伯夷，信如尾生，事王如此者，王能使臣徒步千里以事弱燕之危王乎？'再举酒者之妾'偃仆覆酒'的寓言：妾为救主而故意打翻毒酒，却挨了五十竹笞——'忠信而获罪'正是使命型忠诚的常态。要害有三：其一，区分'对个人的忠'与'对事业的忠'——不离父母之孝、不食周粟之义、抱柱之信，恰是千里赴难、卧底敌国所必需舍弃的；其二，为不义之举预备伦理账本——不是无耻而是有账：每一步'失信'都对应更高一层的责任对象；其三，主动与委托人对齐价值序列——让燕王当庭确认'臣之不信，王之福也'的功利逻辑，取得道德豁免。方法论签名：忠诚不是一个名分，而是一张排好序的责任清单。
thinking_modes.definition_en: When the conventional definition of loyalty obstructs the mission, reprice it: slandered at Yan, Su Qin asked the king whether a man as filial as Zeng Shen, as upright as Boyi, as true as Weisheng could tramp a thousand li to serve a weak, endangered Yan—then told the parable of the concubine who spilled the poisoned wine to save her master and was flogged for it: 'punished for loyalty' is the normal condition of mission-grade fidelity. Distinguish loyalty to a person from loyalty to a cause; keep an ethical ledger so every 'breach of trust' maps to a higher duty; and align the value ranking with your principal in advance, securing moral license ('my unreliability is your blessing'). Loyalty is not a title but a ranked list of obligations.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《史记·苏秦列传》'忠信获罪'自辩段与酒者之妾寓言
process_zh: 列出俗套清单：把当世推崇的忠孝信义逐项列出，标注每一条与当前使命的冲突点
建立层级账本：为每项'违约'行为登记其所服务的更高责任（对燕国之忠高于对齐王之信）
寓言化自辩：用第三方案例（覆酒之妾）把'忠信获罪'讲成普遍规律，绕开自利嫌疑
取得豁免授权：请委托人当面确认价值排序，使今后的'失信'行为有存档的道德授权
process_en: List the convention: enumerate the era's praised virtues and mark where each collides with the mission
Keep a tiered ledger: for every breach of trust, record the higher duty it serves—loyalty to Yan outranks honesty to Qi
Argue by parable: use a third-party case (the wine-spilling concubine) to frame 'punished for loyalty' as a universal law, dodging self-interest
Get the license: have the principal confirm the value ranking in person, archiving moral authorization for future 'breaches'
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 信如尾生，与女子期于梁下，女子不来，水至不去，抱柱而死——有此之信，王安得徒步而使之齐哉？
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: True as Weisheng, who kept a tryst under the bridge, refused to leave as the water rose, and died embracing the pillar—with such faith, how could you send me a thousand li to Qi?
representative_cases_zh: 燕庭自辩（前314年后）：遭谗失宠后以三贤之短反证己行之长，'臣之不信，王之福也'一语把功利逻辑摆上台面，燕王复其官而更厚遇之
酒者之妾的寓言：为救主而覆酒、为主免死而受笞——苏秦用这个故事为'既救燕又欺齐'的双重行为预备了完整的伦理辩护
入齐自污：故意以'得罪于燕'的人设出奔，把个人名声作为战略资产提前折价出售
反例警示：恪守'事一主不事二主'清誉的义士（如伯夷叔齐），守住了名分却无法执行任何复杂使命——纯粹的名节与使命型忠诚不可兼得
representative_cases_en: Self-defense at the Yan court: he proved by three sages' virtues that his 'unreliability' was the king's blessing, and was restored with greater favor
The wine-spilling concubine: saved the master, took the flogging—a complete ethical brief for serving Yan while deceiving Qi
Self-soiling the exile: he pre-sold his personal reputation as a strategic asset by entering Qi under a fabricated disgrace
Counter-case: the impeccably 'loyal' hermit keeps his name and executes nothing—pure reputational honor and mission-grade fidelity cannot both be kept
modern_applications_zh: 职业道德培训中的'责任冲突'案例教学（对雇主/客户/公众的多重忠诚排序）
危机中的'必要之恶'决策框架（公开辩护前先取得委托人授权）
卧底执法与合规调查中的伦理授权程序
个人品牌管理：区分'名誉资产'与'使命资产'的取舍清单
modern_applications_en: Ethics training on competing loyalties (employer/client/public ranking)
'Necessary evil' decision frameworks with principal authorization before public defense
Ethical authorization procedures in undercover enforcement and compliance
Personal brand management: choosing between reputation assets and mission assets

thinking_modes.definition_zh: 一无所有的谋士撬动六国的秘诀是把每一次小成功变成下一次的抵押品：说燕成功后借燕之资说赵，说赵成功后'以赵王之命'说韩魏，再以'赵王已从'的既成事实压齐楚——每一国的加入都是游说下一国的信用凭证。要害有三：其一，启动资本最小化——苏秦入局时只有口才与揣摩之术，燕国的车马金帛是他借到的第一笔杠杆；其二，既成事实的滚雪球——'赵王奉国以从'之后，说服的难度从'开创'降为'加入'，后来者怕的是错过而非风险；其三，借势的闭环回收——联盟成而佩六国相印，个人从无到有一夜封侯，说明杠杆的最终抵押物是这套方法本身的可复制性。方法论签名：没有资源的人，先服务一个能借到第一笔杠杆的对象。
thinking_modes.definition_en: The penniless strategist's secret for moving six kingdoms: each small win becomes the collateral for the next ask. After Yan, borrow Yan's carriages and gold to reach Zhao; after Zhao, invoke the king's name to sway Han-Wei; then press Qi and Chu with the accomplished fact 'Zhao has joined.' Each accession is a credit voucher for the next pitch. Minimize startup capital (wit and the probing craft were all he had; Yan's stipend was the first borrowed lever); snowball accomplished facts (persuasion shifts from 'pioneer' to 'join or miss out'); and close the loop—six seals, enfeoffed overnight, prove the final collateral is the method's own replicability. He who has no resources first serves someone from whom the first lever can be borrowed.
thinking_modes.source_chapter: 《史记·苏秦列传》'说赵王乃饰车百乘黄金千溢……以约诸侯'诸段
process_zh: 寻找第一杠杆：识别最弱小、最恐惧、因此最愿意投资的对象（燕），用一次成功换取车马金帛
杠杆转押：带着燕的资助与燕王的授权见下一国，把上一站的'人财信'全部作为本站的抵押品
既成事实施压：对后来者只讲'已有几国加入'的事实与'错过即危'的后果，不再从头论证
闭环反哺：联盟成后回守中枢（赵），以从约长身份维护整套体系的运转，让杠杆网络自我强化
process_en: Find the first lever: pick the weakest, most frightened, most willing investor (Yan); trade one win for carriages, gold and credentials
Repledge the leverage: arrive at the next court carrying the previous one's funds and royal mandate—last stop's people, money and credit as this stop's collateral
Press with accomplished fact: tell latecomers only who has joined and what missing out costs; never re-argue from scratch
Close and compound: with the coalition sealed, anchor at Zhao as coalition chief, maintaining the network so the leverage reinforces itself
thinking_modes.key_quote_zh: 使我有雒阳负郭田二顷，吾岂能佩六国相印乎——无产者以天下为质押。
thinking_modes.key_quote_en: Had I two qing of fields near Luoyang, would I ever have worn six seals?—the propertyless stake the world itself as collateral.
representative_cases_zh: 燕起家（前334年）：燕文公'资以车马金帛'送苏秦赴赵——历史上最划算的一笔天使投资，燕国由此获得合纵的创始国地位
赵国杠杆（前333年）：赵肃侯'饰车百乘，黄金千溢，白璧百双，锦绣千纯'资助苏秦游说诸侯——第二级杠杆直接以国库出资
韩魏齐楚的雪崩式加入：每一国面对的已不是'要不要抗秦'而是'别人都加入了我站在哪'——六国相印是把滚雪球变成雪崩的定格
反例警示：反观先说秦惠王——对手太强、无求于人，杠杆为零，雄辩万言亦无功；借势法的第一戒律是'永不向不需要你的人开第一枪'
representative_cases_en: Yan as angel investor (334 BC): carriages, gold and credentials to reach Zhao—the best angel ticket in history, buying Yan founding-member status in the coalition
Zhao as second lever (333 BC): a hundred carriages, a thousand yi of gold, white jade and brocades—the second round funded from the state treasury
The avalanche accession of Han-Wei-Qi-Chu: each court faced not 'resist Qin or not' but 'where do I stand when all have joined'—six seals freezing the snowball into an avalanche
Counter-case: his first, zero-leverage pitch to the powerful, self-sufficient King of Qin failed despite ten thousand words—rule one: never open against a man who needs nothing from you
modern_applications_zh: 创业融资的'逐级杠杆'策略（小客户→标杆客户→融资→扩张）
职业发展的信用链：先服务一个可借其背书的平台
联盟营销与生态合作的滚雪球设计
公益筹款：先拿一个锚定捐赠撬动后续大额
modern_applications_en: Stage-lever fundraising: lighthouse customer → reference → round → expansion
Career credit chains: first serve a platform whose endorsement you can borrow
Snowball design in alliance marketing and ecosystems
Fundraising anchors: land one founding gift to lever the rest
